description: Routing table for the DEFECTIVE agent. Maps a measurement technique to a fitting algorithm, its required inputs, outputs, quality flags and refusal rules. The agent reads this file, picks the route by technique, checks required inputs, and calls the named Python function.

algorithm.name: Simultaneous multi-peak fit (SIMPA-style)
algorithm.objective: least squares on log10(current), all peaks fitted together
algorithm.peak_count_selection: greedy peak addition at largest residual; keep count with lowest BIC
algorithm.uncertainty: covariance from Jacobian, scaled by residual variance

recommended_inputs.data.dark_current_A: dark current to subtract, same length or scalar
recommended_inputs.metadata.heating_rate_K_per_s: needed for frequency factor; energy is still fitted without it, frequency factor is omitted and flagged

TSC.notes: Peak overlap makes the decomposition non-unique. Report n_peaks, BIC and per-peak sigma so the matcher can down-weight weak or overlapped peaks.

algorithm.name: Peak per rate window, link across windows, Arrhenius regression
algorithm.peak_finding: scipy.signal.find_peaks on smoothed spectrum, local Gaussian refinement
algorithm.linking: nearest peak to higher temperature with rate, within max_shift_K
algorithm.regression: weighted linear fit of ln(e/T^2) vs 1/(kT)

required_inputs.data.spectra: list of {temperature_K, signal, t1_s, t2_s} or {temperature_K, signal, emission_rate_per_s}, at least 3 windows

alternative_input.data.arrhenius_points: list of {peak_T_K, emission_rate_per_s} already extracted from a paper

DLTS.notes: Energy does not depend on a peak-shape model. Use laplace_dlts when raw transients are available and emission rates are closely spaced.

algorithm.name: Same as DLTS; signal is current transient amplitude

required_inputs.data.spectra: list of {temperature_K, signal, t1_s, t2_s} or emission_rate_per_s, at least 3 windows

I-DLTS.notes: Preferred for high-resistivity detector crystals where capacitance DLTS is not possible.

algorithm.name: Same as DLTS; photo-excited current transients, correlator or two-gate windows

required_inputs.data.spectra: list of {temperature_K, signal, t1_s, t2_s} or emission_rate_per_s, at least 3 windows

PICTS.notes: Ionic migration in halide perovskites can mimic traps in PICTS. Set flags.ionic_artifact_possible for CsPbBr3 and let the matcher decide.

algorithm.name: Tikhonov-regularized non-negative least squares inverse Laplace transform
algorithm.note: Approximate. Use CONTIN or FTIKREG for production work.

LAPLACE_DLTS.notes: Run at several temperatures, then pass the resulting (T, emission rate) points to analyze_dlts as arrhenius_points.
